row.footnote: With effect from Q1 2014, the coverage of shop space statistics has been expanded to include non-shop retail uses (i.e., food & beverage (F&B), entertainment and health & fitness) and referenced as 'retail space'.  The time series on retail space statistics is available from 2011 onwards.  A map of Central Region showing the fringe and central areas is available in the Urban Redevelopment Authority's website.
